# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-03 from the 2026-11-03 Hub dump.

- 3,206,364 models tracked, 916,441 declare a base model, 949,659 parent links, 90,568 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
